formal_statement: ∀ (σ τ : Type) [Finite σ] (p : MvPolynomial σ ℂ) (g : σ → MvPolynomial τ ℂ) (n : ℕ), (∀ i, (g i).totalDegree ≤ 1) → PEqualNP.Gct.HasBorderDetExpression p n → PEqualNP.Gct.HasBorderDetExpression (MvPolynomial.bind₁ g p) n
plain_statement: Chain link 1, routine (its Lemma 2.1): if p in finitely many variables is a limit of size-n determinants of affine matrices, so is p after every variable is replaced by a polynomial of degree at most one. Source: the unrefereed manuscript of 24 September 2026, A cubic lower bound for border determinantal complexity of the permanent (no arXiv number, cited by arXiv:2610.40484). Read once by a leg of seat-clb-1, not verified by this project.
title: Border determinantal expressions survive an affine substitution of the variables
